annotations.title: Check: the text the paying wallet signs for its access

description: The challenge of the Check access, of its own: the text says what the signature grants (read and use the paid Checks of this wallet for 24 hours), the site and until when to sign, and that it moves no funds and authorizes no destination. chainId is any Check network: on EVM it is the domain of typedData, on Solana it gives proofTransaction. Returns { nonce, message, expiresAt, buildId (check-access-<nonce>), typedData (EVM) | proofTransaction (Solana) }. Sign it with prepare_signing (EVM: a signature step with typedData; Solana: the proofTransaction, never sent), then call check_access. Never use destination_challenge or destination_authorize for the Check: they do not give an access.

chainId.description: EVM: integer from GET /v1/chains (1, 10, 56, 100, 137, 8453, 42161, 43114, 130). Solana: string from GET /v1/svm/chains ("solana-mainnet").

name: check_access_challenge
